node.title: Re: How to know to know if string is utf8 encoded or decoded.
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I'm guessing this might be on Windows? IIRC, Unicode filenames on Windows are a bit of a mess. See all of the replies in threads such as [id://1199723] and [id://1195063]. Otherwise, please provide a [id://1177642] - including runnable code and instructions on how to create files with names such as the ones you're having trouble with, so that the issue can be reproduced.
